scenarios.title: A｜普通提醒
scenarios.setting: 朋友之前答应把餐厅地址发给玩家，但似乎忘记了。

turns.prompt: 你想提醒朋友方便时发送地址，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey, just a quick reminder—could you send me the address when you get a chance?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just a quick reminder—could you send me the address when you get a chance?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Hey! Don’t forget to send me the address :)

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! Don’t forget to send me the address :)
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: Just reminding you about the restaurant address. No rush!

feedback.naturalExpression: Just reminding you about the restaurant address. No rush!
feedback.explanation: “no rush”表示不着急，能让对方知道时间安排可以从容一些。

choices.text: When you have a second, could you send me that address?

feedback.naturalExpression: When you have a second, could you send me that address?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I remind you to send me the address.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just a quick reminder—could you send me the address when you get a chance?
feedback.explanation: “I remind you”像在宣布执行提醒；消息中用“Just a reminder to …”更自然。

turns.text: Oh right! Sorry, completely forgot. Sending it now.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No worries, thanks!

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries, thanks!
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Got it! Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it! Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Perfect, that’s the one. See you later!

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect, that’s the one. See you later!
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

scenarios.title: B｜对方很久没回复
scenarios.setting: 玩家两天前给朋友发过一条需要回复的消息，但一直没有收到回应。

turns.prompt: 你想礼貌跟进一条尚未回复的消息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hey! Just checking if you saw my message from the other day.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! Just checking if you saw my message from the other day.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: Not sure if you saw my last message, so just following up :)

feedback.naturalExpression: Not sure if you saw my last message, so just following up :)
feedback.explanation: “following up”表示跟进此前的事项；带上具体事项，对方就知道要查询哪次沟通。

choices.text: Hey, whenever you get a chance, let me know what you think.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, whenever you get a chance, let me know what you think.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Just checking in—no rush if you’re busy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just checking in—no rush if you’re busy.
feedback.explanation: “no rush”表示不着急，能让对方知道时间安排可以从容一些。

choices.text: Why haven’t you replied to me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hey! Just checking if you saw my message from the other day.
feedback.explanation: 这句容易听成责备未回复；问是否看到消息，或说明事项的时限，更利于继续沟通。

turns.text: Sorry! I saw it and then completely forgot to reply.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Haha no worries, happens to me too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Haha no worries, happens to me too.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: All good! I just wanted to make sure you saw it.

feedback.naturalExpression: All good! I just wanted to make sure you saw it.
feedback.explanation: “All good”表示不介意，随后澄清只是确认对方看到了消息。

choices.text: No problem. So, what do you think?

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. So, what do you think?
feedback.explanation: “what do you think”邀请对方给出意见，不替对方作决定。

scenarios.title: C｜工作上的跟进
scenarios.setting: 玩家两天前给同事发了一份文件，需要对方确认。

turns.prompt: 你想跟进此前发出的工作文件是否已经被查看，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, just following up on the file I sent on Monday. Have you had a chance to look at it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, just following up on the file I sent on Monday. Have you had a chance to look at it?
feedback.explanation: “following up”表示跟进此前的事项；带上具体事项，对方就知道要查询哪次沟通。

choices.text: Hey, just checking in about the report I sent earlier this week.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, just checking in about the report I sent earlier this week.
feedback.explanation: “checking in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: When you get a chance, could you let me know if you’ve reviewed the document?

feedback.naturalExpression: When you get a chance, could you let me know if you’ve reviewed the document?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Just wanted to follow up and see if you need anything else from me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Just wanted to follow up and see if you need anything else from me.
feedback.explanation: “follow up”表示跟进此前的事项；带上具体事项，对方就知道要查询哪次沟通。

choices.text: Did you already check my file?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, just following up on the file I sent on Monday. Have you had a chance to look at it?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以询问是否看过；“Have you had a chance to …?”给对方尚未有空的情况留出余地。

turns.text: Sorry, I haven’t had a chance yet. I’ll look at it this afternoon.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. This afternoon works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. This afternoon works for me.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Sounds good, thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sounds good, thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great. If possible, could you send me your feedback by the end of the day?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. If possible, could you send me your feedback by the end of the day?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks, I appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Perfect, thank you!

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect, thank you!
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
